grader.notes: Auto-fail call (final_score=0.0): Gareth follows opening/closing branding ([00:00], [16:34]), manages his single hold properly ([06:48]-[08:12]), verifies address and PIN early ([00:25]-[00:47]), paraphrases accurately ([01:11]), probes thoroughly into wired Cat6 speed tests, ONT light levels, and BNG logs ([01:40]-[06:12]), and remembers every technical figure without re-asking. items.name: Probing
